introduction: You are a registered nurse in a surgical unit at a specialty hospital. Your role involves preparing patients for surgery and ensuring they fully understand and consent to their procedures. Mr. Ricardo Gonzalez is scheduled for a laparoscopic cholecystectomy at 1030. Jeremy Daniels, the PA, meets you in the hallway to share the details of the surgery with you. Your task is to confirm your understanding of the surgery procedure with the PA, engage in a conversation with the patient to address his concerns, and guide him through the consent process with patience, tact, and competence.

default_chat.Jay: Good morning, Mr. Gonzalez. I'm a registered nurse, and I am here to have you sign the consent form and get you ready for surgery. What did Jeremy tell you about your procedure?
default_chat.Ricardo_Gonzalez: He said he would poke some holes into my stomach and remove my gallbladder, but I don't really get what he means. How will I be able to eat if I have holes in my stomach?
default_chat.PA: I reviewed the consent form with the patient who will receive the lap chole with 5 buttonhole incisions into the abdomen. Start an IV because he will receive a dose of cephalosporin to decrease the risk of infection, and dexamethasone for systemic analgesia. Also, draw a T&C and have a unit of packed RBC's on hand. Please have Mr. Gonzalez sign the consent form so that we can proceed with the preparations for the surgery. He is scheduled for surgery at 1030. Do you have any questions?
